$comment: History course outline. v1 holds only the 116 sprint track (S1); the zero-to-hero core is added at M1. Edit this JSON, never docs/curriculum/.
subject: history
decisions: 116 sprint first (owner, 2026-11-15): review chapters for students who studied the required subject in school; the full zero-to-hero core follows for 117.
Owner (2026-11-28): the 社會 sprint has about 57 chapters (歷史 15, 地理 20, 公民 19, 社會綜合 3), at most 5 codes per 30-minute chapter as in the science sprint.
Owner (2026-11-28): one subject at a time in the order 地理 → 公民 → 歷史, then the shared 社會綜合 part (social.json).

Owner (2026-11-28): no new components for the sprint. Sources and statutes are quoted blocks with provenance and an as-of date, attributed readings use Perspective, maps are schematic Graph drawings labelled 示意圖, time-sensitive values use Fact, and drawing items are rubric self-checks.
Teaching order follows research/verified-2026-11-15.json final_units; every official dependsOn edge between covered codes is respected.
Practice items are original and only modelled on the 111–115 papers; official papers are linked, never copied.
The sprint follows the 課綱 themes A→O (research final_units order); the 國中 chronological backbones of the full design are not repeated, and needed 國中 facts are recapped in place.

Contested codes (design 03 §1.5): Da-Ⅴ-2 and Db-Ⅴ-2 get chapters of their own, so the contested-topic gate covers as little else as possible; F-Ⅴ-1 and Nb-Ⅴ-2 sit in their themes' chapters, which are flagged contested as a whole.
歷史考察 E, J and O have no content of their own and are tested through skills (115 Q38), so they are reviewed together in the history exam-skills chapter.
Sources are SourceCard-style quoted blocks (who, when, why, for whom; type; what it can and cannot show), with recorded provenance, public-domain or open-licensed only.
openQuestions: Da-Ⅴ-2: the 課綱 names only document types. Which treaties, declarations, resolutions and communiqués the chapter shows, and their official archive URLs, are not in the frozen research; the owner must approve the list (link plus short quote; foreign-government document reuse is open).
Licences of 國史館 and 國家人權博物館 materials are open (design 03 §1.3); until settled, s116-228-white-terror-justice links them and quotes briefly.
History/civics 考試說明 例題 numbers come from the older 108年9月 file (design 03 §0.4); they can't be re-checked against the 108.11.08 file without new research.
Ib-Ⅴ-2 needs a short primer on 共產主義 and 社會主義, which the 課綱 teaches only later in Lb-Ⅴ-2; the primer is given in place, with a link forward.
Exam-item links (examItems) and reviewed concepts (reviews) are added per chapter in S2.

title.zh-tw: 臺灣：如何認識過去、族群與經濟文化
title.en: Taiwan: knowing the past, peoples, economy and culture

question.zh-tw: 誰的歷史？誰留下的史料？誰寫的歷史？
question.en: Whose history, whose sources, and who wrote it?

parts.whyHere: Research units 1–5 (A, Ba, Bb, Ca, Cb). A opens the course because its questions (H6–H8: source, fact, interpretation) are used by every later chapter, contested ones above all.

title.en: GSAT 116 sprint

title.zh-tw: 如何認識過去：史料、事實與解釋
title.en: How we know the past: sources, facts and interpretations

blurb.zh-tw: 以「誰的歷史？誰留下的史料？誰寫的歷史？」檢視敘述，區分史料、歷史事實與歷史解釋，並判斷史料的證據力。
blurb.en: Testing an account with 'whose history, whose sources, who wrote it?', telling sources, facts and interpretations apart, and judging what a source can prove.

objectives.zh-tw: 用「誰的歷史？誰留下的史料？誰寫的歷史？」檢視一段歷史敘述
objectives.en: Test a historical account with 'whose history, whose sources, who wrote it?'

objectives.zh-tw: 區分史料、歷史事實與歷史解釋
objectives.en: Tell sources, historical facts and interpretations apart

objectives.zh-tw: 判斷一手與二手史料各能證明什麼、不能證明什麼
objectives.en: Judge what first-hand and second-hand sources can and cannot show

chapters.activity: 116 sprint review chapter: key ideas, original 學測-style worked examples, documented traps only, links to official CEEC items by year and number, self-check quiz. Sets the claim types (fact with source / attributed interpretation / question) that the contested chapters use. 考試說明 例題11 (two historians on Alexander) and 例題12 (a memoir vs a later book) are the patterns; here practise on new, public-domain sources. Timelines and 民國/公元 dating recapped in place (國小 Cb).

title.zh-tw: 原住民族與移民社會的形成
title.en: Indigenous peoples and the making of an immigrant society

blurb.zh-tw: 我群界定與原住民族的分類、當代原住民族的處境與權利伸張、清帝國時期的閩粵移民，以及戰後各方移民、婚姻移民與移工。
blurb.en: Self-definition and the classification of indigenous peoples, their situation and rights today, Hokkien and Hakka migrants under the Qing, and post-war migrants, marriage migrants and migrant workers.

objectives.zh-tw: 說明我群界定，以及外來者如何命名與分類原住民族（含平埔族群）
objectives.en: Explain how indigenous groups defined themselves and how outsiders named and classified them, including the 平埔 peoples

objectives.zh-tw: 說明當代原住民族的處境與權利伸張
objectives.en: Describe indigenous peoples' situation today and how they claim their rights

objectives.zh-tw: 比較清帝國時期閩粵移民與戰後來臺移民、婚姻移民與移工
objectives.en: Compare Qing-era Hokkien and Hakka migrants with post-war migrants, marriage migrants and migrant workers

chapters.activity: 116 sprint review chapter: key ideas, original 學測-style worked examples, documented traps only, links to official CEEC items by year and number, self-check quiz. Exam links: 考試說明 例題14-3 (姓名權, Ba-Ⅴ-2), 例題4-2 (粵人 settlement and Qing 分而治之), 例題9-1 (林爽文事件), both Bb-Ⅴ-1. The 說明 asks for a brief recap of each regime's indigenous policy (國中) first. 課綱 wording: 原住民族, 平埔族群, 清帝國. Balance checklist (§1.5 rule 8).

title.en: Economic life and the cultures of mountain and sea

blurb.zh-tw: 臺灣歷史上的商貿活動與土地問題，原住民族的語言、信仰與祭儀，多元的信仰，以及從傳統到現代的文學與藝術。
blurb.en: Trade and land questions in Taiwan's history, indigenous languages, beliefs and rites, many religions, and literature and art from tradition to the present.

objectives.zh-tw: 說明臺灣歷史上的商貿活動與島嶼經濟的特色
objectives.en: Explain trade in Taiwan's history and what makes an island economy

objectives.zh-tw: 分析臺灣歷史上的土地問題，包括原住民族土地課題
objectives.en: Analyse land questions in Taiwan's history, including indigenous land

objectives.zh-tw: 說明原住民族的信仰祭儀、多元信仰與從傳統到現代的文學藝術
objectives.en: Describe indigenous rites, the many religions, and literature and art from tradition to today

chapters.activity: 116 sprint review chapter: key ideas, original 學測-style worked examples, documented traps only, links to official CEEC items by year and number, self-check quiz. Exam links: 114 Q54–56 (清代大小租; 合科 with civics 交易成本 and 所有權); 115 Q30 (日治 land and forest surveys and 原住民傳統領域); 考試說明 例題9-2 (金娘 as 平埔族群 from three clues, Cb-Ⅴ-1).

title.en: Taiwan: shaping a modern state

question.zh-tw: 臺、澎、金、馬如何成為一體？追求自治與民主走過哪些路？
question.en: How did Taiwan, Penghu, Kinmen and Matsu become one polity, and what paths led to self-rule and democracy?

parts.whyHere: Research units 6–7 (Da, Db). Da-Ⅴ-2 and Db-Ⅴ-2 each get a chapter of their own under the contested-topic rules; the rest of D is reviewed first.

title.en: GSAT 116 sprint

note.zh-tw: 給已在學校讀過必修歷史、準備考 116 學測的同學：重點複習，不是從零開始。完整的從零課程將在 117 學年度課程中推出。

title.zh-tw: 從地方到中央：治理、建設與自治民主
title.en: From local to central: governance, infrastructure and self-rule

blurb.zh-tw: 從十七世紀的地方行政到中央憲政體制，國民教育、「國語」運動與基礎建設，日治時期的政治社會運動，以及戰後的社會運動。
blurb.en: From 17th-century local administration to central constitutional government; schooling, the 「國語」 movements and infrastructure; political and social movements under Japanese rule; and post-war social movements.

objectives.zh-tw: 說明從十七世紀地方行政到中央憲政體制、從威權到民主的轉變，以及「臺澎金馬」一詞何時出現
objectives.en: Trace the change from 17th-century local administration to central constitutional government and from authoritarianism to democracy, and when the term 臺澎金馬 came into use

objectives.zh-tw: 說明國民教育、兩次「國語」運動，以及交通、時間與度量衡等基礎建設
objectives.en: Explain national schooling, the two 「國語」 movements, and infrastructure such as transport, time and measurement

objectives.zh-tw: 說明日治時期的政治參與要求與社會運動，以及戰後的社會運動
objectives.en: Describe demands for political participation and social movements under Japanese rule, and post-war social movements

chapters.activity: 116 sprint review chapter: key ideas, original 學測-style worked examples, documented traps only, links to official CEEC items by year and number, self-check quiz. Exam links: 考試說明 例題14-2 (evidence of 皇民化, Da-Ⅴ-3), 例題6 (queue cutting in 1913 臺中, Db-Ⅴ-1). 課綱 wording: 日治時期, 「國語」運動 in quotation marks, 戰後, 中華民國統治體制的移入與轉變. Balance checklist (§1.5 rule 8).

title.zh-tw: 國際局勢與臺灣地位：條約、宣言、決議與公報
title.en: International politics and Taiwan's status: treaties, declarations, resolutions and communiqués

blurb.zh-tw: 先讀文件本身：因戰爭訂定的條約、宣言、決議與公報寫了什麼，再並列比較對臺灣地位的不同解釋與其依據。
blurb.en: Reading the documents first: what treaties made after wars, declarations, resolutions and communiqués say, then setting the differing readings of Taiwan's status side by side with what each rests on.

objectives.zh-tw: 依文件類型讀出條約、宣言、決議與公報本身的內容與出處
objectives.en: Read what each treaty, declaration, resolution and communiqué itself says, and where it comes from

objectives.zh-tw: 並列比較對臺灣地位的不同解釋，以及各自依據的證據
objectives.en: Set the differing interpretations of Taiwan's status side by side with the evidence each relies on

objectives.zh-tw: 用史料判讀說明解釋為何不同
objectives.en: Use source criticism to explain why the interpretations differ

chapters.activity: 116 sprint review chapter: key ideas, original 學測-style worked examples, documented traps only, links to official CEEC items by year and number, self-check quiz. CONTESTED (design 03 §1.5): open with the 課綱's own framing question; 課綱 wording by default; every sentence typed as documented fact (primary-source citation), attributed interpretation (named author or body, work, year, in a Perspective) or the course's own question; at least two cited perspectives of equal size, ordered by publication date; the teacher voices no position; a 「爭議地圖」 box; ships only after the claim-type audit, the second reviewer, the owner's full read and a changelog entry. Primary text before interpretation (rule 5): show the documents, linked to official archive copies and quoted briefly, then the readings side by side; never assert a single legal conclusion on 臺灣地位 or sovereignty. Which documents is an open question for the owner.

title.zh-tw: 二二八事件、白色恐怖與轉型正義
title.en: The 228 Incident, the White Terror and transitional justice

blurb.zh-tw: 以有出處的檔案與口述史料認識二二八事件與白色恐怖的人權侵害、受難者與家屬的經歷，以及轉型正義的追求。
blurb.en: Using archives and testimony with clear provenance to understand the rights violations of the 228 Incident and the White Terror, what victims and their families lived through, and the pursuit of transitional justice.

objectives.zh-tw: 以有出處的檔案與口述史料說明二二八事件與白色恐怖的人權侵害
objectives.en: Use archives and testimony with clear provenance to describe the rights violations of the 228 Incident and the White Terror

objectives.zh-tw: 說明不同性別、族群的受難者與家屬的經歷
objectives.en: Describe the experiences of victims and families of different genders and ethnic groups

objectives.zh-tw: 說明轉型正義的意涵與追求
objectives.en: Explain what transitional justice means and how it is pursued

chapters.activity: 116 sprint review chapter: key ideas, original 學測-style worked examples, documented traps only, links to official CEEC items by year and number, self-check quiz. CONTESTED (design 03 §1.5): open with the 課綱's own framing question; 課綱 wording by default; every sentence typed as documented fact (primary-source citation), attributed interpretation (named author or body, work, year, in a Perspective) or the course's own question; at least two cited perspectives of equal size, ordered by publication date; the teacher voices no position; a 「爭議地圖」 box; ships only after the claim-type audit, the second reviewer, the owner's full read and a changelog entry. title.en: China and East Asia

question.zh-tw: 可以在什麼樣的脈絡中討論中國史？「中國」的意涵又如何改變？
question.en: In what contexts can Chinese history be discussed, and how has the meaning of 「中國」 changed?

parts.whyHere: Research units 9–16 (F, Ga, Gb, Ha, Hb, Ia, Ib; J goes to the exam-skills chapter). F opens the part with the 課綱's framing question.

title.en: GSAT 116 sprint

note.zh-tw: 給已在學校讀過必修歷史、準備考 116 學測的同學：重點複習，不是從零開始。完整的從零課程將在 117 學年度課程中推出。
note.en: For students who studied required history in school and sit the 116 GSAT: a focused review, not zero-to-hero. The full lessons arrive in the 117 course.

title.zh-tw: 討論中國史的脈絡、國家與社會
title.en: Contexts for Chinese history; state and society

blurb.zh-tw: 討論中國史的不同脈絡與「中國」意涵的變化，傳統政治權威的類型，戶籍、土地與賦役的統治技術，以及民間社會組織與國家的互動。
blurb.en: Different contexts for Chinese history and the changing meaning of 「中國」, types of traditional political authority, ruling through household registers, land and labour service, and how social organisations dealt with the state.

objectives.zh-tw: 說明「中國」意涵的變化，以及可以在哪些脈絡中討論中國史
objectives.en: Explain how the meaning of 「中國」 changed and in which contexts Chinese history can be discussed

objectives.zh-tw: 比較傳統政治權威的類型，以及戶籍、土地、賦役與國家統治的關係
objectives.en: Compare types of traditional political authority, and how household registers, land and labour service served rule

objectives.zh-tw: 說明民間社會組織的型態，以及它們與國家的互動
objectives.en: Describe forms of social organisation and how they dealt with the state

chapters.activity: 116 sprint review chapter: key ideas, original 學測-style worked examples, documented traps only, links to official CEEC items by year and number, self-check quiz. CONTESTED (design 03 §1.5): open with the 課綱's own framing question; 課綱 wording by default; every sentence typed as documented fact (primary-source citation), attributed interpretation (named author or body, work, year, in a Perspective) or the course's own question; at least two cited perspectives of equal size, ordered by publication date; the teacher voices no position; a 「爭議地圖」 box; ships only after the claim-type audit, the second reviewer, the owner's full read and a changelog entry. title.en: People on the move in East Asia

blurb.zh-tw: 漢晉至宋元、明清時期東亞的人群移動，以及十九世紀以後東亞的移民與其影響。
blurb.en: Movements of people in East Asia from the Han and Jin to the Song and Yuan, under the Ming and Qing, and migration since the 19th century and its effects.

objectives.zh-tw: 說明漢、晉到宋、元時期東亞人群移動的原因與影響
objectives.en: Explain why people moved in East Asia from the Han and Jin to the Song and Yuan, and what followed

objectives.zh-tw: 比較明、清時期國家主導的遷徙與民間的海外移動
objectives.en: Compare state-directed moves with voluntary overseas migration under the Ming and Qing

objectives.zh-tw: 說明十九世紀以後東亞人群移動的變遷與影響（在地化、回流、排斥、認同改變）
objectives.en: Explain how migration in East Asia changed after the 19th century and its effects (localisation, cultural flow home, backlash, changing identity)

chapters.activity: 116 sprint review chapter: key ideas, original 學測-style worked examples, documented traps only, links to official CEEC items by year and number, self-check quiz. Exam link: 考試說明 例題3-2 (雲南 Muslims to 緬甸, Hb-Ⅴ-1). 114 試題特色 calls 人群的移動與交流 a new perspective of the 108 curriculum. 112 Q9 and Q19 are cited by a secondary report only: use them only if the slice verifies them.

title.en: Where tradition met the modern

blurb.zh-tw: 明末清初與晚清西方文化傳入的比較，東亞國家對帝國主義的回應，以及民間社會與現代化的激盪。
blurb.en: Western culture reaching East Asia in the late Ming and early Qing compared with the late Qing, East Asian responses to imperialism, and society's encounter with modernisation.

objectives.zh-tw: 比較明末清初與晚清西方文化傳入東亞的影響
objectives.en: Compare the effects of Western culture reaching East Asia in the late Ming and early Qing and in the late Qing

objectives.zh-tw: 比較自強運動、變法、立憲、辛亥革命、明治維新與越南革命運動對帝國主義的回應
objectives.en: Compare the responses to imperialism: the Self-Strengthening Movement, reform, constitutionalism, the 1911 Revolution, the Meiji Restoration and Vietnam's revolutionary movements

objectives.zh-tw: 用「衝擊—反應」與以中國為中心的觀點解讀同一事件
objectives.en: Read one event through the 'impact–response' view and a China-centred view

chapters.activity: 116 sprint review chapter: key ideas, original 學測-style worked examples, documented traps only, links to official CEEC items by year and number, self-check quiz. Exam link: 115 Q43–44 混合題組 (衝擊—反應 vs a China-centred view applied to 義和團; Q44 得分率 40%, 4-point written item). The two viewpoints are attributed interpretations in Perspective blocks.

title.en: War and peace in East Asia

blurb.zh-tw: 二十世紀東亞人民的戰爭經驗、共產主義在東亞的發展，以及區域合作與經貿統合。
blurb.en: What East Asian people lived through in the 20th century's wars, communism's course in East Asia, and regional cooperation and economic integration.

objectives.en: Describe the 20th century's major wars from ordinary people's side, and reflect on how war can be avoided

objectives.zh-tw: 說明共產主義在東亞的發展歷程及其對局勢的影響
objectives.en: Explain how communism developed in East Asia and how it changed the region

objectives.zh-tw: 說明東南亞公約組織、東南亞國協與亞太經濟合作會議等區域合作
objectives.en: Describe regional cooperation such as SEATO, ASEAN and APEC

chapters.activity: 116 sprint review chapter: key ideas, original 學測-style worked examples, documented traps only, links to official CEEC items by year and number, self-check quiz. Exam links: 考試說明 例題10 (金瓜石 Allied POWs), 例題14-1 (高砂義勇隊 and the Pacific War), both Ib-Ⅴ-1. A short in-place primer on 共產主義 / 社會主義 (taught in Lb-Ⅴ-2), linking forward to s116-individual-liberty-reason.
